notes.title: Escape from Deathmark Dungeon Release
notes.notes:
Escape from Deathmark Dungeon will release on the 14th of April, the day before Good Friday.

To accompany the release is a video of the developer playing a short session of the game to outline how it is played on YouTube.

[previewyoutube=jGFtYgaQvDU;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoy!
